title: Benchmarking Web Agent Defenses Against Adaptive Visual Prompt Injection

title: Conartist: Adaptive Agentic Red-Teaming of Computer-Using Agents against Multi-Step Prompt Injection

title: ArguShield: Enforcing Minimum-Necessary Disclosure in Tool-Calling LLM Agents
hint: Large language model agents increasingly use third-party tools to complete user tasks. Even without malicious intent, they may fill broad or weakly constrained fields with private information that is unnecessary or inappropriate for the receiving tool. Such calls can satisfy the tool schema and complete the task, yet still violate minimum-necessary disclosure.
